name: Ctenosuchus
sum: Ctenosuchus is an aeolodontine teleosaurid thalattosuchian with widely spaced needle-like teeth from the Middle Jurassic Anoual Formation of Morocco.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated on the page; two specimens are known, both with partial skulls and osteoderms.
biology: Its needle-like teeth may have helped it trap small prey (English Wikipedia).
author: Imran et al. 2026

sources.text: Imran, H., Martill, D. M., Smith, R. E., Zouhri, S., Gunn, J. and Ibrahim, N. 2026. A new teleosauroid (Crocodylomorpha, Thalattosuchia) with a unique dentition from the Middle Jurassic of eastern Morocco. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology e2728670.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Bathonian per English Wikipedia; whole ICS stage used.
